body:
### Features
- **LLM Observability:** Add support for OpenAI Agents (trace-processor) [#8044](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/8044)
- **span-stats:** Encode SpanKind and GRPCStatusCode in v0.6 stats payload [#9190](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9190)

### Fixes
- **Feature Flags:** Allow custom agentless endpoints [#9481](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9481)
- **General:** Make peer service finalization idempotent [#9364](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9364)
- **LLM Observability:** Address OpenAI Agents review feedback [#9526](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9526)
- **LLM Observability:** Format AI SDK rich tool results [#9399](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9399)
- **LLM Observability:** Llm observability traces have custom trace IDs [#9460](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9460)
- **standalone:** Stamp _dd.apm.enabled on every span [#9506](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9506)
- **Test Optimization:** Harden validation workflow [#9431](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9431)
- **Test Optimization:** Reject malformed settings policies [#9362](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9362)
- **webpack:** Opt out of typescript auto resolve [#9521](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9521)

### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking)
- **aws-sdk:** Disable clock skew correction in the Lambda spec [#9537](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9537)
- **release:** Exclude release proposal branches from license auto-commit [#9522](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9522)
- **Test Optimization:** Cover worker thread preload [#9528](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9528)
